---
title: "Buffer & Proximity Tool"
date: 2026-09-11
categories: [tool, vector]
description: "Upload points, lines, or polygons and generate a buffer at any distance — as a single zone or several concentric rings — see what's within reach of each feature, optionally dissolved into one shape, colored on the map, downloadable. Runs entirely in your browser, powered by Python."
page-layout: full
---

Upload a point, line, or polygon file, set a distance, and see the
area within that reach of every feature — a buffer. Works the same
way whether you're asking "what's within 300m of this store" or
"what falls within 50m of this road." Set more than one ring to break
that reach into distance bands instead of one zone — "within 100m",
"100–300m", "300–500m" — each shown as its own shade on the map.

::: {.callout-tip}
**Private by design.** Your file is processed entirely in your
browser (Python via WebAssembly) — it's never uploaded to any server,
including ours. Nothing to configure, nothing to trust: the code
never gets the chance to see your data.
:::

```{.webgeods-python #buffer-inspect-py}
#| package: geopandas
import geopandas as gpd

def export_crs(g):
    # Reprojects `g` (a WGS84 GeoDataFrame) back to the CRS the file
    # was UPLOADED in — every downloadable result goes through this,
    # even though the map/computation above always work in WGS84.
    # Same pattern as this project's other vector tools.
    if g is None or original_crs is None or str(original_crs) == "EPSG:4326":
        return g
    return g.to_crs(original_crs)

EMPTY_FC = {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": []}

gdf = None
for path in ["/uploaded.geojson", "/uploaded.shp", "/vsizip//uploaded.zip"]:
    try:
        gdf = gpd.read_file(path)
        break
    except Exception:
        pass

crs_warning = None
original_crs = None
summary_out = None
if gdf is not None:
    if gdf.crs is None:
        gdf = gdf.set_crs("EPSG:4326")
        crs_warning = "No CRS found in the uploaded file — assuming WGS84 (EPSG:4326)."
    original_crs = gdf.crs
    if str(original_crs) != "EPSG:4326":
        gdf = gdf.to_crs("EPSG:4326")

    if "name" not in gdf.columns:
        gdf["name"] = [f"feature {i + 1}" for i in range(len(gdf))]

    summary_out = {
        "count": int(len(gdf)),
        "crs": str(original_crs),
        "geometryTypes": sorted(set(gdf.geometry.geom_type))
    }

{
    "features": gdf.__geo_interface__ if gdf is not None else EMPTY_FC,
    "crsWarning": crs_warning,
    "summary": summary_out
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// A function, not a static constant: the number of rings is chosen
// per run. Opacity fades from 0.6 (closest ring) down to ~0.15
// (farthest) via a match expression on each feature's own "ring"
// property -- same "match" mechanism as Spatial Clustering's cluster
// colors, applied to opacity instead of hue since these are ordered
// distance bands, not unrelated categories. ringCount=1 resolves to
// the single 0.35 opacity this tool always used before rings existed.
ringPaint = (ringCount) => {
  const opacityExpr = ["match", ["get", "ring"]];
  for (let i = 1; i <= ringCount; i++) {
    const opacity = ringCount === 1 ? 0.35 : 0.6 - (i - 1) * (0.45 / (ringCount - 1));
    opacityExpr.push(i, Number(opacity.toFixed(2)));
  }
  opacityExpr.push(0.35);
  return {
    "fill-color": "#42583c",
    "fill-opacity": opacityExpr,
    "fill-outline-color": "#2a2117"
  };
}
```

```{.webgeods-python #buffer-compute-py}
#| inject: [bufferDistance, dissolveBuffers, ringCount]
#| package: geopandas
gdf_calc = gdf.copy()

# Working/calculation CRS: a buffer distance is a real distance, so
# it must run on projected (metric) coordinates, never degrees --
# same reasoning, same UTM auto-pick formula (from the data's own
# bounding-box center, not a per-feature centroid mean -- avoids the
# GeoPandas geographic-CRS warning, see Spatial Clustering's own
# fix), as this project's Viewshed and Spatial Clustering tools.
minx, miny, maxx, maxy = gdf_calc.total_bounds
center_lon = float((minx + maxx) / 2)
center_lat = float((miny + maxy) / 2)
utm_zone = int((center_lon + 180) // 6) + 1
calc_epsg = 32600 + utm_zone if center_lat >= 0 else 32700 + utm_zone
calc_crs_label = f"EPSG:{calc_epsg}"

gdf_proj = gdf_calc.to_crs(epsg=calc_epsg)

ring_count = max(1, int(ringCount))
max_distance = float(bufferDistance)
ring_distances = [max_distance * i / ring_count for i in range(1, ring_count + 1)]

# Each ring is an ANNULUS (the difference from the previous, closer
# ring), not a repeat of the full buffer -- ring 1 is "within 100m",
# ring 2 is "within 200m but not already within 100m", and so on.
# ring_count=1 collapses to exactly the original single-buffer
# behaviour (one ring, no differencing needed).
#
# dissolveBuffers changes WHERE the union happens, not just whether
# it happens, and the order matters: dissolving each feature's own
# rings first and only unioning same-numbered rings together
# afterwards (the first version of this) breaks down the moment two
# features are close enough for their rings to reach past EACH OTHER,
# not just their own -- a sliver of "close to feature B" area could
# get labelled ring 2 (from feature A's perspective) even though it's
# genuinely within ring 1 of feature B, visually inverting near/far
# colors exactly where two features interact. Dissolving the FULL
# buffer at each distance first, across every feature, THEN
# differencing consecutive dissolved levels, avoids that by
# construction: ring i is always "within ring i of ANY feature, not
# already within ring i-1 of ANY feature" -- the actually-intended
# meaning of a dissolved ring.
ring_rows = []
if dissolveBuffers:
    previous_geometry = None
    for i, distance in enumerate(ring_distances):
        level_geometry = gdf_proj.geometry.buffer(distance).union_all()
        ring_geometry = (
            level_geometry.difference(previous_geometry)
            if previous_geometry is not None
            else level_geometry
        )
        ring_rows.append({
            "name": f"ring {i + 1}",
            "ring": i + 1,
            "ringDistance": distance,
            "geometry": ring_geometry
        })
        previous_geometry = level_geometry
else:
    for _, row in gdf_proj.iterrows():
        previous_geometry = None
        for i, distance in enumerate(ring_distances):
            buffer_geometry = row.geometry.buffer(distance)
            ring_geometry = (
                buffer_geometry.difference(previous_geometry)
                if previous_geometry is not None
                else buffer_geometry
            )
            ring_rows.append({
                "name": row["name"],
                "ring": i + 1,
                "ringDistance": distance,
                "geometry": ring_geometry
            })
            previous_geometry = buffer_geometry

ring_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(ring_rows, crs=gdf_proj.crs)

ring_gdf_wgs84 = ring_gdf.to_crs("EPSG:4326")

{
    "features": ring_gdf_wgs84.__geo_interface__,
    "originalCrsFeatures": export_crs(ring_gdf_wgs84).__geo_interface__,
    "summary": {
        "calculationCrs": calc_crs_label,
        "bufferDistance": max_distance,
        "ringCount": ring_count,
        "ringDistances": [round(d, 1) for d in ring_distances],
        "dissolved": bool(dissolveBuffers),
        "bufferCount": int(len(ring_gdf))
    }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// The distance slider + dissolve checkbox + Compute button, rebuilt
// whenever inspectSummary changes -- same "disabled with an
// explanatory message until there's data" pattern as Raster
// Calculator's own band-math row.
bufferControlsRow = {
  const s = inspectSummary;
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "webgeods-panel-row";

  if (!s) {
    const status = document.createElement("span");
    status.className = "webgeods-panel-status";
    status.textContent = "Upload a file or load the example to set a distance.";
    row.append(status);
    return row;
  }

  const slider = WebGeoDS.createSlider([10, 2000], {
    value: 100,
    step: 10,
    label: "Buffer distance (m)",
    id: "buffer-distance-control"
  });

  const ringSlider = WebGeoDS.createSlider([1, 5], {
    value: 1,
    step: 1,
    label: "Rings",
    id: "ring-count-control"
  });

  const dissolveLabel = document.createElement("label");
  dissolveLabel.className = "webgeods-panel-status";
  const dissolveCheckbox = document.createElement("input");
  dissolveCheckbox.type = "checkbox";
  dissolveCheckbox.id = "dissolve-buffers-control";
  dissolveLabel.append(dissolveCheckbox, " Dissolve overlapping buffers");

  const computeButton = document.createElement("button");
  computeButton.className = "webgeods-panel-btn";
  computeButton.textContent = "▶ Compute";
  computeButton.onclick = async () => {
    computeButton.disabled = true;
    const originalText = computeButton.textContent;
    computeButton.textContent = "⌛ Computing...";
    try {
      const bufferDistance = Number(document.getElementById("buffer-distance-control").value);
      const ringCount = Number(document.getElementById("ring-count-control").value);
      const dissolveBuffers = document.getElementById("dissolve-buffers-control").checked;
      window.bufferDistance = bufferDistance;
      window.ringCount = ringCount;
      window.dissolveBuffers = dissolveBuffers;
      await window.WebGeoDS.CodeCell.find("buffer-compute-py").run();
      const result = document.getElementById("buffer-compute-py").value;
      await sharedMap.setGeoJSON("buffer-result-py", result.features, { paint: ringPaint(ringCount) });
      await sharedMap.fitToData(result.features);
      mutable exportFeatures = result.originalCrsFeatures;
      mutable resultSummary = { ...result.summary, bufferDistance, ringCount, dissolveBuffers };
      window.WebGeoDS.track?.("validation_completed", { tool: "buffer-proximity" });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("buffer-proximity: Compute failed", err);
      mutable uploadStatus = `⚠️ Compute failed: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      computeButton.disabled = false;
      computeButton.textContent = originalText;
    }
  };

  row.append(slider, ringSlider, dissolveLabel, computeButton);
  return row;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Gated on resultSummary (a completed Compute), not just an upload --
// downloading an unbuffered file wouldn't be this tool's own output.
downloadButton = {
  const button = document.createElement("button");
  button.className = "webgeods-panel-btn";
  button.dataset.variant = "outline";
  button.textContent = "⬇ Download";
  button.disabled = !resultSummary;
  button.onclick = async () => {
    if (!exportFeatures) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    const originalText = button.textContent;
    button.textContent = "⌛ Preparing...";
    try {
      const base = WebGeoDS.Upload.baseName(uploadedFiles);
      WebGeoDS.downloadBlob(
        JSON.stringify(exportFeatures, null, 2),
        base ? `${base}-buffered.geojson` : "buffered.geojson",
        "application/geo+json",
        { tool: "buffer-proximity" }
      );
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = originalText;
    }
  };
  return button;
}
```

//| echo: false
statCard = {
  const s = inspectSummary;
  const r = resultSummary;
  const box = document.createElement("div");
  box.className = "webgeods-stat-grid";

  const row = (label, value) => {
    const dt = document.createElement("div");
    dt.className = "webgeods-stat-label";
    dt.textContent = label;
    const dd = document.createElement("div");
    dd.className = "webgeods-stat-value";
    dd.textContent = value;
    box.append(dt, dd);
  };

  if (!s) {
    row("Features", "—");
    row("—", "Upload a point/line/polygon file or load the example above");
    return box;
  }

  row("Features", s.count.toLocaleString());
  row("Geometry", s.geometryTypes.join(", "));
  row("Original CRS", s.crs === "None" || !s.crs ? "Unknown" : s.crs);

  if (r) {
    row("Calculation CRS", r.calculationCrs);
    row("Buffer distance", `${r.bufferDistance} m`);
    row("Rings", r.ringCount === 1 ? "1 (no ring split)" : `${r.ringCount} (at ${r.ringDistances.join(", ")} m)`);
    row("Dissolved", r.dissolveBuffers ? "Yes" : "No");
    row("Buffer features", r.bufferCount);
  }

  return box;
}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
legendEl = {
  const r = resultSummary;
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "webgeods-legend";
  if (!r) {
    wrap.hidden = true;
    return wrap;
  }
  wrap.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  wrap.style.rowGap = "8px";

  const addSwatch = (opacity, text) => {
    const swatch = document.createElement("div");
    swatch.className = "webgeods-legend-bar";
    swatch.style.flex = "0 0 32px";
    swatch.style.background = `rgba(66,88,60,${opacity})`;
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "webgeods-legend-label";
    label.textContent = text;
    wrap.append(swatch, label);
  };

  if (r.ringCount === 1) {
    addSwatch(0.6, `Buffer (${r.bufferDistance} m)`);
    return wrap;
  }

  let previousDistance = 0;
  r.ringDistances.forEach((distance, i) => {
    const opacity = 0.6 - i * (0.45 / (r.ringCount - 1));
    addSwatch(opacity.toFixed(2), `${previousDistance}–${distance} m`);
    previousDistance = distance;
  });
  return wrap;
}
```
